description: Ideate skill evaluation suite — one-artifact flow (#1581)

metadata.notes: Post-#1581: /ideate authors the Design & Rationale section of the unified docs/specs/ artifact within the initial `plan` phase (no separate `ideate` phase, no ideate→plan transition). It records artifacts.spec via exarchos_workflow update and chains to /plan without transitioning. The 2-3 approach divergent loop is the `deep` rung, not a default — exercised by the capability-llm and deep regression/golden scenarios.

config.rubric: Evaluate the Design & Rationale ideation for a `deep`-depth feature. Score 1 if 2+ distinct approaches are explored with pros/cons AND a selection rationale is given. Score 0.5 if 2+ approaches are explored with pros/cons but no selection rationale. Score 0 if only one approach is considered or no trade-off analysis is present. (At thin/standard depth a single converged approach is correct and is graded by the spec-artifact and DR-N coverage assertions, not by this multi-approach rubric.)

regression.description: Known-good ideation traces that must not regress (one-artifact flow)
